content:
Goal
* Please change "contains" to "has".

* Please change "its cards" to "the value of their cards".

Input
* Both descriptions: Please fix the typos: seperated => separated.

* Next P lines: Please add "held by one player" after "the cards".

Output
* Please change "packs" to "players".

Cases
* Five cases contain a card value of 0, which violates the third constraint.

* Please remember that each test and its validator should cover the **same scenario**. Refer to the following points for cases to modify or add.

* Triple Player (Test 2): Please swap the order of "6 4 2 9" and "7 3 5 1" to cover the scenario where the first player doesn't have the maximum sum, similar to Validator 2.

* Many Cards (Test 3): Please move the line "2 5 3 9…" to the end of the input to cover the scenario where the final player has the maximum sum.

* More cards... (Validator 3): Please replace this validator with Big party (Validator 4).

* Big party (Validator 4): Please create a new case with P > 2, C > 5, where all players have the same sum but different card values, similar to Test 4.

* Please create a new pair of cases where P = 1 and C = 20.

* Please create a new pair of cases where P = 10 and C = 1.

* Please create a new pair of cases that satisfy all of the following conditions:
  • P = 10
  • 5 ≤ C ≤ 9
  • The maximum sum is held by the second-to-last player.
  • 2 players hold the second-highest sum.
  • 3 players hold the third-highest sum.
  • 4 players hold the minimum sum.
  • Players other than the maximum-sum player should be randomly ordered.
  • Players who have the same sum don't have the same cards.

Thanks.
